Holiday home · Carinthia, Austria

The lake, the mountains and the trails. Outside high season, you nearly have them to yourself.

Our detached Panorama Lodge is at EuroParcs Pressegger See, within walking distance of one of Carinthia's warmest lakes. In spring and autumn it's quiet, colourful and perfect for hiking and cycling.

✓ Up to 6 guests✓ 3 bedrooms✓ Sun terrace✓ Free Wi-Fi

Why outside summer?

The best season is the quiet season

Quiet trails

No queues at lifts, huts or viewpoints. Hike at your own pace through the Carnic and Gailtal Alps.

Nature in full colour

Alpine meadows in bloom in spring, golden larches around the lake and in the Gailtal valley in autumn.

Sunny Carinthia

Carinthia lies on the sunny southern side of the Alps. You notice it in the weather, the light and the food.

Three countries close by

Right by the border triangle: take a day trip to Italy or the Slovenian Alps.

Things to do

What to do each season

Mid-May

Carinthian Hiking Opening

The region opens the hiking season with a festive weekend in the nearby Lesachtal valley: guided walks, alpine pastures and local specialities.

All spring

Around Lake Presseggersee

An easy 5.9 km walk (about 1.5 hours) through the reed beds around the lake. Perfect for your first morning.

April–June

Cycling the Gailtal valley

Flat valley routes for the whole family and plenty of climbs for mountain bikers. E-bikes can be hired locally.

All spring

Fishing at sunrise

The lake is known for its clear water and healthy fish stocks. Permits are sold locally.

All spring

Carnic Alps Geopark

Trails across what was once seabed, with fossils and geotrails for all ages.

Event dates vary from year to year. See nassfeld.at for the current programme.

Day trips

Möderndorf, near Hermagor

Garnitzenklamm gorge

A gorge about 4.5 km long with waterfalls, sheer rock walls and emerald pools. Open in the warmer months; some sections need sure footing.

More info ↗

Lake Presseggersee

Paddleboarding on the lake

Glide over the calm, clear water on a SUP board. Lovely on a mild spring or autumn day.

City day out

Villach and Klagenfurt

Two charming Carinthian towns for a day of shopping, cafés and culture.

Winter

Tröpolach

Skiing from the Millennium Express

We always start at the Millennium Express. Tip: rent a ski locker at the bottom so you don't have to carry anything. Then après-ski at Zum Alois.

More info ↗

Practical

Austria

Required in your car

A warning triangle, a high-vis vest for every passenger, an in-date first-aid kit and a motorway vignette (digital from ASFINAG or at a petrol station before the border). Police do sometimes check.

Panorama Lodge
